calls.title: Demo Call with Harshita Shyam from Expedia Group
calls.summary: The team discussed the increasing need for a scalable experimentation platform that can support complex B2B use cases, particularly driven by machine learning projects related to recommendation models in various domains. Principal engineer Abhay Rawat emphasized that the existing in-house platform is effective for B2C but inadequate for company-level experiments with longer sales cycles. GrowthBook was introduced as a promising open-source solution, used by over 3,200 companies, offering a secure and customizable platform with no raw data leaving user environments. The architecture supports high-scale, low-latency experimentation and integrates seamlessly with AWS services. The platform's deployment options provide full data control, making it suitable for enterprises. The team agreed on the next steps, focusing on preparing use cases and questions for a tailored demo.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, B2B, GrowthBook, Data Warehouse, Feature Flagging, Machine Learning
calls.action_items:
